name: create_checkpoint
title: create_checkpoint
description: Commits the current state of the project directory as a rollback point, using the message '[ai-checkpoint] <label>'. Requires the project to be a git work tree. Mutating tools do this automatically; call it explicitly to mark a milestone you may want to return to.

label.description: Short description of what this checkpoint captures.

created.description: False when the work tree was already clean.

errors.git_unavailable: The project directory is not a git work tree, or git is not on PATH.
errors.git_add_failed: git add failed; output is in the message.
errors.git_commit_failed: git commit failed; output is in the message.
